_about: Single source of truth for the 5 character presets of the SWR personas. Every register (Editorial / Dark / Friendly / Dashboard / Brutalist) renders this same data in its own visual register. Tweak here, all 5 pages update on next regen.
_note: When generating a register, embed this JSON inline in the HTML so each page is self-contained. The .personas.js file in the project root is the runtime version for the live <personas-block> component.

section.title: Who actually uses this.
section.lede: The engine and its 5 versions were built for people who have audio and a release date, and zero budget for a video editor. The profiles below are the ones who reach for it first.

personas.name: Indie musician
personas.body: Releasing a single with no video budget. Loads the mastered WAV, picks a style, gets a 30s MP4 for the post.

personas.name: Beatmaker
personas.body: Selling beats on BeatStars / Airbit. Renders a 15s preview per track so the listing beats a static waveform.

personas.name: DJ
personas.body: Promoting a mix or a set. 60s vertical teaser with BPM burned in frame 1, cuts on the downbeat, ready for Reels.

personas.name: Small label
personas.body: 3–10 artists a year, one brand voice. Uses the same version across the roster so every release reads as the label.

personas.name: Belgrade / Serbian artist
personas.body: Local pricing (€25 vs €40+ in the EU), in-person demo at KC Grad, Drugstore, or Dot. Same engine, different margin.

personas.name: Podcaster
personas.body: One long episode, ten short clips. Renders each pull-quote moment as a 15s visual to drive follows from the audio feed.

personas.name: Sound designer
personas.body: Sample pack creator showcasing the patches. The visualizer becomes the cover art — engine output doubles as marketing.

personas.name: Music manager / agency
personas.body: Visual content for the whole roster. One tool, one workflow, ten artists' worth of social posts per month.
